subject: ISV Rollout Synchronization — staggered release checklist and API timetable
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@dockwork.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: ISV Rollout synchronization — staggered release checklist and API timetable

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. DockWork's integration is one of the earliest ISV rollouts for our new SDK v3 surface, and we want to make sure the deployment window works for both sides.

High level ask: can DockWork accept a staggered rollout (canary -> cohort -> GA) across regions rather than an abrupt cutover? That lets us monitor telemetry and quickly enable a compatibility shim if we see regressions.

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Sept 28: internal canary (Redwood-only traffic)
- Oct 5: DockWork canary (1% of DockWork traffic, us-west)
- Oct 12: DockWork cohort (10% traffic, us-west + us-east)
- Oct 19: GA (all regions)

Key compatibility items we need your sign-off on:
- Backwards-compat header (X-RW-SDK-Version) to detect older clients
- Fallback model routing if inference schema changes
- Short test harness run (3 business days) on your staging after we flip a canary

Can you confirm whether DockWork can accept the staggered approach and the proposed dates? If not, please propose alternatives. CC'ed Vanessa and Marissa from Alliances to help coordinate release orchestration.

Thanks,

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
From: Elena Torres <elena@dockwork.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@consultech.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV Rollout synchronization — staggered release checklist and API timetable

Ben —

Appreciate the clear plan. DockWork is generally comfortable with a staged rollout but would like to request a slight shift and two items clarified:

1) Shift cohort dates by one week (cohort -> Oct 19, GA -> Oct 26) to accommodate a partner marketing window.
2) We need a short list of exact schema fields that are considered "breaking" vs "additive" so our SDK generator can adapt without manual changes.

Also looping in Samir (our external integration lead) — he can help run the staging harness and verify load scenarios.

If you can provide an API change summary PDF and a migration checklist (even a skeleton) we can confirm by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Elena
—
Elena Torres
Head of Integrations
DockWork
[Attachment: none]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: ISV Rollout synchronization — staging checklist + compatibility mitigations

Team — forwarding DockWork reply and summarizing mitigation items for our release engineers.

Notes / proposed mitigations:
- Provide DockWork with an "API change summary" (PDF) that categorizes fields as breaking/additive and lists semantic version thresholds. (Ben: see attached api-change-summary.pdf draft)
- Prepare a lightweight compatibility shim that maps old request shapes to new ones (runtime flag-controlled). Target: can be deployed behind a feature flag for 48 hours during canary.
- Add the X-RW-SDK-Version header and a telemetry tag so our SREs can route/rollback by client version.
- Create a concise migration checklist for DockWork (one page) and a more detailed migration workbook (attached: dockwork-migration-plan.xlsx).

I'll take point on the feature-flag deployment plan and coordinate with runtime to reserve the Oct 5 slot for the DockWork canary. Karthik, can you validate the backward-compat shim effort estimate (fyi: expected 2 dev-days + 1 QA day)?

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Alliances
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: api-change-summary.pdf; dockwork-migration-plan.xlsx]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@dockwork.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.p@consultech.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV Rollout synchronization — staggered release checklist and API timetable

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Vanessa's notes and your ask, attached are the two items you requested:
- api-change-summary.pdf — concise field-by-field categorization (breaking vs additive) + semver thresholds
- dockwork-migration-plan.xlsx — staging checklist, test cases, rollback triggers, and contact roster

Finalized, agreed timeline (per DockWork request):
- Sept 28: internal Redwood canary
- Oct 5: DockWork canary (1% traffic, us-west)
- Oct 19: DockWork cohort (10% traffic, us-west + us-east)
- Oct 26: GA (all regions)

Launch checklist (short):
- [ ] DockWork signs migration checklist (sheet: "owner signoffs")
- [ ] Compatibility shim deployed behind feature flag
- [ ] X-RW-SDK-Version telemetry verified in staging
- [ ] 72-hour monitoring window in place for canary; rollback criteria documented
- [ ] Post-GA review scheduled (two-week retro)

Next steps: Elena — please confirm sign-off on the migration checklist and the shifted dates by Monday EOD. Samir — we'll send the staging credentials and harness runbook after sign-off.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: api-change-summary.pdf (2 pages); dockwork-migration-plan.xlsx (7 sheets)]
